# AP News

> > The Associated Press's global news service covering breaking news, politics, sports, business, entertainment, and investigative journalism from around the world.

AP News is the digital news platform of The Associated Press, one of the world's oldest and most trusted news organizations. The site provides comprehensive coverage of international and domestic news, featuring reporting from AP journalists stationed globally, covering everything from major political events and environmental issues to sports championships and cultural trends.

## Key Topics

- Breaking news coverage
- International relations
- Environmental impact and fracking
- NFL and professional sports
- Civil rights and racial justice
- Military and defense
- Business and financial markets
- Water contamination issues
- UN resolutions and diplomacy
- College and professional athletics
- Cultural trends and entertainment
- Legal proceedings and death penalty cases
- Energy and renewable power
- European banking and economic concerns
